about: Landing from a fall V1 (docs/gameplay/fall_landing_v1_plan.md 2): a hard landing kept on the feet, 0.6 s (health/FallLanding sends it on a damaging fall that is not a fall-over): down through the knees and hips, the pelvis tipped forward, back up. The legs and hips only (mask legs), so the arms keep what the held item does; the own first person keeps its view model, the camera rides the posed eye down and up (first_person_eye). Written by tools/medical-actions-v1a/author_fall_v1.cjs from the approved concept.
